name: Costa Brava Coastline via Sant Grau
description: Classic Girona loop to the Costa Brava coastline through Sant Grau. 6.3km climb to the monastery, stunning coastal roads past Tossa de Mar, returning via quiet country lanes.

name: Els Àngels Loop
description: The classic climb to Santuari dels Àngels where Dalí married. Two climbs through woodland and medieval villages in the Gavarres.

name: Mare de Déu del Mont
description: 18km averaging 5.4% with sections hitting 14%. Quiet rolling countryside, forest terrain, and panoramic summit views. Returns via Banyoles lake.

name: Sant Hilari Sacalm & Susqueda Dam
description: Punchy loop with 1,710m of climbing. 20km climb to Sant Hilari Sacalm, twisting forest descents, and the dramatic Susqueda dam.

name: Coll de Bracons
description: Remote Catalan mountain pass north of Vic. Quiet roads through farmland rising to a serious climb with Pyrenean views.

name: Empordà Plain
description: Flat and rolling through the Empordà agricultural plain. Medieval villages, vineyards, and very little traffic. Perfect for steady-state or tempo work.

name: Rocacorba Gravel
description: The gravel approach to Rocacorba through the Gavarres fire roads. Where discipline boundaries blur.

name: Les Gavarres
description: Deep in the Gavarres cork oak hills. Rolling terrain on quiet roads through one of Catalonia's least-visited corners.

name: Turó de l'Home
description: Highest point in the Montseny massif. Serious climbing through dense forest to a radio tower summit with views to Barcelona.

name: Via Verde del Carrilet
description: Former railway line converted to greenway. Flat, traffic-free, perfect for families or recovery rides. Girona to Olot through volcanic countryside.

name: La Traka 100
description: The La Traka gravel race route. 100km of Girona's best gravel through the Gavarres, Empordà, and volcanic zone. Race-validated.
